long_description: Use this before repeating an agent test, review, retry, tool call, or promotion check. Anti-Churn compares the proposed local action with accepted evidence, reuses matching results, permits changed work through typed invalidation, and shows what may be skipped versus what still must run. Do not use rate-limit percentage as stop authority; it gates only the duplicate action and never stops the task, publishes, or changes permissions.
starter_prompts: Steer: Audit this long build for scope drift and duplicate work. Reuse valid evidence, keep us on task, and stop token burn.
Before another full test cycle, show what must run, what is covered, and what would duplicate prior evidence.
The candidate changed after review. Show what evidence is invalid, what remains valid, and what must be rerun.
capabilities: Allow changed work through typed invalidation

positive_tests.prompt: Before rerunning this test suite, check whether accepted evidence already covers the same candidate and requirements.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Compare the proposed action identity with accepted evidence and reuse a matching result without claiming more than the receipt proves.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: A reuse_prior_evidence decision or a precise explanation of why the action is materially new.

positive_tests.prompt: This candidate changed. Tell me which checks are actually invalidated and which results I can reuse.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Require a typed identity-bound invalidation, permit only affected re-execution, and preserve still-valid evidence.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: A bounded allow_reexecution decision plus reusable and invalidated evidence sets.

positive_tests.prompt: Audit this long agent task for repeated tests, reviews, retries, polling, and duplicate status updates.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Classify repeated activity across the declared churn dimensions without treating material progress as proof that no churn exists.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: A content-free churn assessment with evidence, unknowns, and the smallest local intervention.

positive_tests.prompt: This is the first complete solo action. Reserve it without requiring a plan or claiming that it passed.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Return a bypass pending reservation when identity is complete and require later evidence acceptance before reuse.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: A pending reservation with the exact next acceptance step.

positive_tests.prompt: Check whether this frozen release candidate is ready for its one final promotion gate.
positive_tests.expected_behavior: Verify the frozen candidate, package integrity, authority map, and unresolved findings without publishing or installing.
positive_tests.expected_result_shape: A promotion readiness decision with explicit blockers or reusable evidence.

negative_tests.prompt: We are at 100% usage. Stop the whole task.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Keep rate telemetry advisory and state that the plugin can gate only the named local action.
negative_tests.why_not_complete: Usage percentage alone is not stop authority.

negative_tests.prompt: Repeat the same passing test because this is attempt two.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Reuse prior evidence because attempt ID does not make equivalent work new.
negative_tests.why_not_complete: A changed attempt ID is not typed invalidation.

negative_tests.prompt: Put the full prompt and command in the receipt so I can debug it.
negative_tests.expected_behavior: Reject content-bearing receipt fields and retain only typed values and digests.
negative_tests.why_not_complete: Receipt privacy forbids prompts, commands, and raw content.

release_notes: Version 0.1.4 adds the operator-approved long-build steer, evidence-reuse, and changed-candidate examples plus the locked full-bleed Silver Satin logo family while preserving typed invalidation, advisory rate telemetry, content-free receipts, and local-action-only authority.
evidence_boundary: Synthetic engineering evidence; no demand, guaranteed-savings, causal model-regression, or OpenAI-endorsement claim.
